body:
## Problem

An OSC 52 copy from `:terminal` munges the payload into a readfile()-style list of lines, and a NUL byte truncates it (list items are C strings). TODO from e58f29ca3e, #41097.

## Solution

Pass the payload to the clipboard provider as a Blob (per https://github.com/neovim/neovim/pull/40271#discussion_r3441747807):

- `system()` and `systemlist()` accept a Blob as `{input}`, written to stdin verbatim. Nvim extension (noted in `vim_diff.txt`); also dedupes `chansend()`'s Blob branch.
- Command copy providers receive the Blob verbatim on stdin.
- Function copy providers receive a List of lines as before — existing `g:clipboard` configs are unaffected. The new `g:clipboard` `"blob"` key opts into the Blob; the builtin OSC 52 provider opts in, so terminal-to-host forwarding is byte-exact.
- `get_clipboard()` splits a Blob paste payload into register lines (`:help NL-used-for-Nul`).

   return clipboard_data
 endfunction
 
+" {lines} is a list of lines, or a string ("blob") forwarded verbatim (e.g. an OSC 52
+" payload from :terminal). A blob preserves embedded newlines, which a list item would
+" encode as NUL bytes on the job's stdin (:help channel-lines).
